description_en: To leave something completely or stop supporting it
example: They had to abandon the plan because of the cost.
note: Common in business and academic contexts

description_en: Something good and difficult that you have succeeded in doing
example: Graduating from university was a major achievement for her.

description_en: Giving attention to detail and avoiding mistakes
example: Please be careful when entering the financial data.

description_en: In a way that achieves good results without wasting time or resources
example: The team completed the project efficiently and on schedule.

description_en: Used to introduce a fact that makes another fact surprising
example: Although the task was difficult he finished it on time.
